scope: One DT run per task matching cited rollout budgets. This is not a reproduction of the papers' algorithms, models or reported scores.

Webshop.differences: Pinned upstream script inherits webshop.use_small=True (1k products) and human_goals=False. Full chat history and 32k/1024 limits follow our fixed method, not the paper's 4096/512 and history length 2. Original paper minibatch 64 and gamma .95 are not substituted. One run, not three-seed aggregate.

Sokoban.differences: Budget comes from the pinned official script; the paper does not separately state Sokoban iteration count. Our existing text rendering and Qwen3.5-9B differ from the paper's visual Qwen2.5-VL-3B setup. Official process rewards and one-box configuration stay fixed. One run, not three-seed aggregate.

AppWorld.differences: LOOP source gives nominal 240 rollouts and early-stops stragglers at >=90%; our fixed owner collects all 240. No LOOP filters, reward normalization, trained value model or replacement PPO are added. Existing VERL official success reward 10/0 stays fixed; LOOP used test-pass fractions. The original max response 1500, LoRA rank16, LR5e-5 and minibatch32 are not substituted. Dev evaluation uses existing owner 40-turn loop, versus paper evaluation 50. One run, not three-seed aggregate.
